utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let me know what needs fixing and when you want to start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is it starting at 10 this Saturday by the community center entrance?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—10 this Saturday at the community center entrance works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to confirm the details, but I think they may need help sorting donations and managing drop-off times. I’d rather double-check before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense — just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I can help spread the word then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check on the details and make sure we’ve got the timing and needs straight before anything gets set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, I’m getting the repair drive organized now—want to help me make a quick list of what the neighbors need most?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help with that. Let’s start with the most common fixes, and I’ll jot them down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Mara—let’s start with the biggest urgent repairs and then add anything else folks mention. I’ll keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, go ahead—what problem are you seeing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’d be happy to help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you bring the toolbox and a flashlight? We’ll check the drive first, then see what else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s nice to see everyone pitching in. I’m heading by later to see if they still need any tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word too and make sure folks know to bring any tools or parts they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll check in later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I can start sorting the donations and set aside anything obvious. Just point me to the tables.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Uli — the tables are just by the community hall entrance. Thanks for jumping in; I’ll send folks your way as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — I’m on it at the hall entrance.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’m still a bit behind, but I can try to bring any spare parts I’ve got. What time are folks heading over?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re starting at 10, if that works for you. Spare parts would be a big help, and I’ll be there to help sort and carry things in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — 10 works, and I’ll bring whatever spare parts I can find. Thanks for helping me keep up!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what’s the first urgent repair you want me to note?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s start with the broken lamp folks mentioned—if you can note what parts it needs, I’ll check my toolbox and bring anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll note the broken lamp and any parts it needs. If you’ve got a bulb or wiring bits, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the drive itself first, so I can tell you exactly what needs fixing. If you have a moment, I can describe the problem I’m seeing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—go ahead and tell me what you’re seeing. I’ll still swing by a bit late and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’m seeing a few cracks and some uneven spots, so I want to check whether anything’s leaking or unsafe before we start.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal—I'm still keeping track of what supplies we're short on for the repair drive. If you spot any extra screws, nails, or working flashlights, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—I'll keep an eye out for those. If I hear where the repair drive is happening, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal, I appreciate that. I’m still watching for screws, nails, and working flashlights in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The busiest pickup window is usually 3:00 to 3:30, and I’m generally available after 4 on weekdays. I can also do a bit more on Wednesdays and weekends.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. If 4 or later works best, I’ll keep that in mind and let you know if I spot more tools or spare parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Noah—thanks. Just keep me posted, and I can help coordinate around pickup times if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m happy to spread the word and invite a few more neighbors too. If you want, I can also make sure Sam gets the details about where and when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I already have the details, and I’m checking around for extra screws, nails, and a couple working flashlights. I’ll bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s awesome, Sam — thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know you’re bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess—if you can, please keep an eye out for any extra screws, nails, and a couple of working flashlights. I’m tracking what we’re still short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, nails, and a couple of working flashlights. If I spot any extras, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess—just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep track of anything we’re still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s nice to see everyone pitching in. I’m going to stop by and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — if you hear where it’s happening, let me know. I’m still trying to pin down the location and start time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know as soon as I find the spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ve got a minute—what problem are you seeing with it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still getting the details, but it sounds like tools and spare parts are the big need. If you can bring the toolbox, that should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the toolbox and a few spare parts, just in case. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly sorting donations and helping carry things in? I can probably come by at 10 if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: 10 works for me—thanks! I’ll have my tools ready, and we can sort things out when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll be there at 10. Just point me to whatever needs sorting first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m happy to spread the word and invite a few more neighbors too. If you want, I can also help point folks to the right place and time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Could you point people to the drop-off table and ask them to leave any tools there?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll point them to the drop-off table and ask them to leave any tools there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After 4 on weekdays is best for me, and Wednesdays or weekends give me a little more flexibility. I can help figure out the pickup times around that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Faye. Let’s keep pickup after 4 on weekdays, and I’ll plan around Wednesday or the weekend if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just let me know the repair drive times, and I’ll work around pickup after 4 or on Wednesday/weekend if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I almost spaced on that. What still needs doing, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll check around for extra screws, nails, and a couple working flashlights and bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam. I’ll bring the Phillips screwdriver and check for the spare fuses before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to inspect the drive itself first so I can be precise about what needs fixing. If you have a moment, I can describe the problem I’m seeing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds sensible, Hana. Let me know what you’re seeing, and I’ll try to keep track of the details so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia. I’m seeing a couple of places that look uneven, and I want to check whether there’s any cracking or loose sections before we set anything in stone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’ll still be a bit late, but I’ll jump in as soon as I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane—just hop in when you arrive. I’ve got the urgent stuff started, so we’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—thanks for starting things off. I’ll be there as soon as I can and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mostly tools and spare parts, I think — I’m not totally up to speed either. If you’ve got any, they’d probably be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll check what tools and spare parts I can round up. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — if you come across any hand tools or small replacement parts, those would be great. I’m still a bit scattered, so just tell me what turns up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what time should I show up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. Any time after 2 works best—just text me when you’re on the way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll text you when I’m on the way, after 2.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time it starts and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 6:00 PM, and we’re meeting by the community shed. I’ll bring the list so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — 6:00 PM by the community shed. Can you confirm you’ll bring the list?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
